entries.title: Ezekiel 21:1
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:2
segments: Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop [a word] toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:3
segments: And say to the land of Israel, So says the LORD: Behold, I [am] against you, and will draw out My sword out of its sheath and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:4
segments: Since then I will cut off the righteous and the wicked from you, therefore My sword shall be drawn from its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:5
segments: so that all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn out My sword from its sheath. It shall not return any more.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:6
segments: And you, son of man, groan with the breaking of [your] loins; and grown with bitterness before their eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:7
segments: And it will be when they say to you, Why do you groan? You shall answer, Because of the news [that] it is coming; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak [ as] water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:8
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:9
segments: Son of man, prophesy and say, So says the LORD. Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:10
segments: It is sharpened in order to slaughter; it is polished so that there may be a flash to it. Or shall we rejoice? You are despising the rod of My son, [as if it were] every tree.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:11
segments: And He has given it to be polished, to be taken by the hand. The sword, it is sharpened, and it it polished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:12
segments: Cry and howl, son of man; for it [shall be] on My people; it [shall be] on all the rulers of Israel. They are thrown to the sword with My people; Therefore slap [your] thigh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:13
segments: Because [it is] a trial, and what if even the despising rod shall not be? says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:14
segments: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike [your] hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain. It [is] the sword of the slain, the great one that surrounds them;

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:15
segments: so that [their] heart may melt, and many stumble at all [their] gates. I have given the threatening sword. Ah! It is made like lightning; it is wrapped for a slaughter.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:16
segments: Sharpen yourself on the right! Set yourself on the left, wherever your face is set.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:17
segments: And also I, I will also strike My hands together, and I will cause My fury to rest. I the LORD have spoken.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:18
segments: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:19
segments: And you, son of man, set for yourself two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. Both of them shall come out of one land. And create a hand at the head of the way to the city; create it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:20
segments: You shall set a way that the sword may enter [into] Rabbah of the Ammonites, and [into] Judah, into fortified Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:21
segments: For the king of Babylon shall stand at the parting of the way, at the head of the two highways, to practice divination. He shall shake arrows; he shall ask household idols; he shall look at the liver.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:22
segments: At his right shall be the divining [for] Jerusalem, to set [battering] rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering-rams against the gates, to pour out and to build a siege wall.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:23
segments: And it shall be to them an empty divining before their eyes, those who have sworn oaths to them. But He will remember iniquity, that they may be taken.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:24
segments: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, in that your sins are revealed in all your deeds; because you have been remembered, you shall be taken with the hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:25
segments: And you, O slain, wicked king of Israel, of whom has come his day in the time of iniquity of the end.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:26
segments: So says the Lord Jehovah: Remove the diadem, and take off the crown. This [shall] not [be] as it was. Lift up the low one, and put down the high one.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:27
segments: Ruin, ruin, ruin, I will appoint it. Also this shall not be until the coming of Him whose is the right. And I will give it to Him.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:28
segments: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their shame. Even say: The sword, the sword [is] drawn, polished for slaughter to make an end, that [it may be] like lightning;

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:29
segments: while they see false visions for you, while they divine a lie to you, to put you on the necks of the slain of the wicked whose day has come in the day of iniquity; [it shall have] an end.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:30
segments: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:31
segments: And I will pour out My disgust on you; with the fire of My wrath I will blow against you, and give you into the hand of burning men, able to destroy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:32
segments: You shall be for food to the fire. Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall be remembered no [more]; for I the LORD have spoken.
